preconditions.description: Input n must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if n == 0 else return_value == numTrees(n - 1) + numTrees(n - 2)
postconditions.description: For n = 0, the result is 0. For n > 0, the result equals the sum of the number of unique BSTs for n-1 and n-2, following the Catalan number recurrence relation.
